object_review.notes: Seashell arrangement; detected shell is not a donut. Other shells are missed.
Open book by a cup; book is misclassified as cake.
Rose wall misclassified as pizza; no actionable food object.
Cafe composition includes a potted plant, cup and newspaper. One cup detection does not certify a single dominant subject.
Bread loaf on paper is predicted as sandwich. Box spans loaf and wrapping; class correspondence and complete-region target are uncertain.
Clearly visible single coffee cup; cup and handle lie within the detected region. Hand and clothing provide context, not another target. This is not an aesthetic rating.
Table contains multiple drinks and a plate; detector returns only one primary cup.
Small cup and large bag both contribute to the composition; detector alone cannot establish intended primary subject.
Meal table includes multiple dishes and drinks; single bowl box is insufficient for whole-scene guidance.
Cake group includes multiple slices and a cup; box covers one slice rather than the arrangement.
Ketchup bottle is a background prop beside a cup receiving a pour; largest detected object is not a reliable primary subject.
Broccoli box is one ingredient inside a large platter; cannot guide the complete meal from that box.
One complete pizza is the dominant subject and lies inside the detector region; plate is contextual. This does not establish aesthetic quality.
Single coffee cup is clear and correctly classified; spill and spoon remain contextual, so cropped regions must still preserve visible content. No aesthetic rating.
Open refrigerator contains many groceries; selecting one door bottle would misrepresent the intended full scene.
